classification: Standalone C# counterfactual purchase-controller experiment; production Simulation is unchanged
rules: All conditions share production combat/enemy/reward equations and costs. No build-specific multipliers.
Baselines and candidates purchase before combat on ticks30,60,...; one paid action per second and identical available income at the purchase boundary.
Each candidate has independent combat-purchase cursor; unsuccessful purchases wait; capped upgrades skipped. Branch or repair purchase does not move combat cursor.
A: max6 tips; next branch requires Supply>=2*nextBranchLv and Damage>=2*nextBranchLv. Cycle Damage,Supply,Speed,Damage,Width.
B: max9 tips; next branch requires Supply>=2*nextBranchLv and Damage>=nextBranchLv. Cycle Supply,Speed,Damage,Width,Bleed,Damage.

C: max12 tips; next branch requires Supply>=2*nextBranchLv, Damage>=2*nextBranchLv, Speed>=ceil(nextBranchLv/2). Cycle Damage,Speed,Supply,Width,Supply,Damage. At HP<=4 reserve repair cost and try repair first; production cap5/paid cost applies.
Crystal rate includes 3sec retry wait, excludes PB milestone rewards. TestCompleted is censored, not natural defeat.
limitations: No production change, no optimality claim, no seed selection.
Ten paired seeds reused across six weapons; not 300 independent seeds.
Three candidates are a bounded exploration; repair is an explicit additional cost/action in C.
